mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in the demand for goods and services, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 110.0), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% indicates strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a housing market slowdown (HOUST below 2000.0), weak residential construction activity reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 2000.0.
